zone-settings.sh: a dry run. These are the calls --apply makes; nothing is sent.
A write is sent only for what has drifted.

the zone
  GET /zones?name=omarchy-mac.org
off: Bot Fight Mode
  GET /zones/{zone}/bot_management
  PUT /zones/{zone}/bot_management {"fight_mode":false,"ai_bots_protection":"disabled","crawler_protection":"disabled"}
off: AI-bot blocking
  GET /zones/{zone}/bot_management
  PUT /zones/{zone}/bot_management {"fight_mode":false,"ai_bots_protection":"disabled","crawler_protection":"disabled"}
off: AI Labyrinth
  GET /zones/{zone}/bot_management
  PUT /zones/{zone}/bot_management {"fight_mode":false,"ai_bots_protection":"disabled","crawler_protection":"disabled"}
off: Rocket Loader
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/rocket_loader
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/rocket_loader {"value":"off"}
off: email obfuscation
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/email_obfuscation
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/email_obfuscation {"value":"off"}
off: Always Online
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/always_online
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/always_online {"value":"off"}
off: automatic HTTPS rewrites
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/automatic_https_rewrites
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/automatic_https_rewrites {"value":"off"}
off: Cloudflare Fonts
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/fonts
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/fonts {"value":"off"}
off: the analytics script injection
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/rum
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/rum {"value":"off"}
on: Always Use HTTPS
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/always_use_https
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/always_use_https {"value":"on"}
on: HTTP/3
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/http3
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/http3 {"value":"on"}
on: TLS 1.3
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/tls_1_3
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/tls_1_3 {"value":"on"}
on: 0-RTT
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/0rtt
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/0rtt {"value":"on"}
on: Early Hints
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/early_hints
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/early_hints {"value":"on"}
on: Smart Tiered Cache (tiered caching)
  GET /zones/{zone}/argo/tiered_caching
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/argo/tiered_caching {"value":"on"}
on: Smart Tiered Cache (the Smart topology)
  GET /zones/{zone}/cache/tiered_cache_smart_topology_enable
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/cache/tiered_cache_smart_topology_enable {"value":"on"}
on: Speed Brain
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/speed_brain
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/speed_brain {"value":"on"}
Respect Existing Headers: Browser Cache TTL
  GET /zones/{zone}/settings/browser_cache_ttl
  PATCH /zones/{zone}/settings/browser_cache_ttl {"value":0}
the skip rule on /api/* and /join
  GET /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_firewall_custom/entrypoint
  PUT /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_firewall_custom/entrypoint {"rules":[{"description":"Under /api/ and at /join: no Browser Integrity Check, no managed rules","expression":"(http.host eq \"lab.omarchy-mac.org\" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/api/\") or http.request.uri.path eq \"/join\"))","action":"skip","action_parameters":{"phases":["http_request_firewall_managed"],"products":["bic"]},"logging":{"enabled":true},"enabled":true}]}
the rate rule
  GET /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_ratelimit/entrypoint
  PUT /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_ratelimit/entrypoint {"rules":[{"description":"Flood cap: 300 requests in 10 s per address, whole site","expression":"true","action":"block","ratelimit":{"characteristics":["cf.colo.id","ip.src"],"period":10,"requests_per_period":300,"mitigation_timeout":10},"enabled":true}]}
the cache rules
  GET /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_cache_settings/entrypoint
  PUT /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_cache_settings/entrypoint {"rules":[{"description":"Public pages and exports, for a request without the session cookie or a Lab token, may be cached as labd says","expression":"(http.host eq \"lab.omarchy-mac.org\" and not http.cookie contains \"lab_session=\" and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq \"authorization\") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/deletion\") and (http.request.uri.path in {\"/\" \"/matrix\" \"/models\" \"/features\" \"/gaps\" \"/aurora\" \"/benchmarks\" \"/candidates\" \"/reports\" \"/data\" \"/install\" \"/install/lab\" \"/terms\" \"/privacy\" \"/api/v1/reports\" \"/api/v1/reports.json\" \"/api/v1/reports.csv\" \"/api/v1/checks\" \"/api/v1/checks.csv\" \"/api/v1/matrix\" \"/api/v1/matrix.json\" \"/api/v1/benchmarks\" \"/api/v1/benchmarks.json\" \"/api/v1/aurora\" \"/api/v1/aurora.json\"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/models/\") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/features/\") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/candidates/\") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/reports/\")))","action":"set_cache_settings","action_parameters":{"cache":true},"enabled":true},{"description":"Under /api/: never cached, but an export asked for without the session cookie","expression":"(http.host eq \"lab.omarchy-mac.org\" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, \"/api/\") and (http.cookie contains \"lab_session=\" or not http.request.uri.path in {\"/api/v1/reports\" \"/api/v1/reports.json\" \"/api/v1/reports.csv\" \"/api/v1/checks\" \"/api/v1/checks.csv\" \"/api/v1/matrix\" \"/api/v1/matrix.json\" \"/api/v1/benchmarks\" \"/api/v1/benchmarks.json\" \"/api/v1/aurora\" \"/api/v1/aurora.json\"}))","action":"set_cache_settings","action_parameters":{"cache":false},"enabled":true},{"description":"A request with a Lab token or the session cookie: never cached, whatever the path","expression":"(any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq \"authorization\") or http.cookie contains \"lab_session=\")","action":"set_cache_settings","action_parameters":{"cache":false},"enabled":true}]}
no redirect rule
  GET /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_dynamic_redirect/entrypoint
  PUT /zones/{zone}/rulesets/phases/http_request_dynamic_redirect/entrypoint {"rules":[]}
the mail forwarding rule: privacy@omarchy-mac.org to the mailbox of --forward-to
  GET /accounts/{account}/email/routing/addresses?per_page=50
  POST /accounts/{account}/email/routing/addresses {"email":"<MAILBOX>"}
  GET /zones/{zone}/email/routing
  POST /zones/{zone}/email/routing/dns {}
  GET /zones/{zone}/email/routing/rules?per_page=50
  POST /zones/{zone}/email/routing/rules {"name":"privacy","enabled":true,"matchers":[{"type":"literal","field":"to","value":"privacy@omarchy-mac.org"}],"actions":[{"type":"forward","value":["<MAILBOX>"]}]}
the Alias, once edge.json says alias.wanted (now: false)
the fallback origin: lab.omarchy-mac.org, the Lab address, which the tunnel serves
  GET /zones/{zone}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
  PUT /zones/{zone}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin {"origin":"lab.omarchy-mac.org"}
the custom hostname maclab.omarchy.org: made when missing, its certificate validated over HTTP
  GET /zones/{zone}/custom_hostnames?hostname=maclab.omarchy.org
  POST /zones/{zone}/custom_hostnames {"hostname":"maclab.omarchy.org","ssl":{"method":"http","type":"dv"}}
checked, the owner's to set: DNSSEC
  GET /zones/{zone}/dnssec
checked, the owner's to set: the tunnel-health alert
  GET /accounts/{account}/alerting/v3/policies
checked, the owner's to set: the "tunnel created or deleted" alert
  GET /accounts/{account}/alerting/v3/policies
